column1: # Columns, separated by single tabs: pack, ZIM file base, title, description, approximate size in MiB.
# The ZIM file base is the Kiwix file name without its _YYYY-MM date and .zim ending.
# A ZIM may appear in more than one pack. The size is only a guide for planning; the
# true size and the current edition are read from the live Kiwix catalogue at download
# time (sudo offline catalogue --check), so this file does not go stale.
# The wikipedia-*, medicine-*, survival-*, education-*, diy-*, agriculture-* and
# computing-* packs are the curated collections of Project NOMAD
# tier. As in NOMAD, a standard pack assumes its essential pack and a comprehensive
# pack assumes its standard pack: "sudo offline get medicine-standard" fetches both.
# Put your own additions in /etc/offline/catalogue.local.tsv using the same layout.
